title: Neglected crops: 1492 from a different perspective
source_family: historical agricultural synthesis, independent of HYDE/LUH2
license: FAO publication; no open redistribution license verified; cache for research, cite and paraphrase only

interpretations.claim: Wheat, barley and rye are described as colonial introductions; rice appears among introduced crops accompanying colonial livestock expansion.
interpretations.model_implication: Do not retain 0.5 physical-fallback eligibility for these crops in documented pre-Columbian American agricultural systems.
interpretations.scope: Documented Spanish/Portuguese American agricultural systems; exact exclusion geometry still to be frozen.
exclusions: Do not infer a Greenland/Norse exclusion from this colonial Latin American account.
Do not treat Oryza crop keys as North American wild rice (Zizania).
interpretations.role: historical availability constraint, not a yield or population fitting target

interpretations.claim: Andean quinoa marginalization is associated with introduced barley and wheat.
interpretations.model_implication: Audit missing indigenous Andean crops before interpreting zero current-field crop support as genuinely negligible.
interpretations.role: missing crop-system diagnosis; no numerical yield assignment authorized by this excerpt
